originalTitle: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
summary: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.
content:
South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics skyrocketed in Seoul on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks after blockbuster earnings from Amazon and Microsoft revived optimism around artificial intelligence spending.

SK Hynix was last trading over 25% higher, putting it on course for its best day on record if gains hold. Samsung rose more than 20%. LG Innotek advanced 11.2% and Seoul Semiconductor rose 7.8%.

Japanese chip stocks also rallied sharply. Advantest , climbed nearly 18%, while Tokyo Electron gained almost 9%, Disco rose over 13%, Lasertec advanced more than 12% and Renesas Electronics added over 10%. SoftBank Group , a key artificial intelligence proxy as its owns Arm , also jumped more than 9%.

The chip rally in Asia marks a sharp reversal from this week's bruising sell-off, as semiconductor stocks were battered by concerns over lofty AI valuations and signs of intensifying competition from Chinese memory chipmakers.

The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) surged more than 8% overnight, as investors piled back into AI-linked chipmakers following stronger-than-expected cloud results from the two U.S. tech giants.

Amazon jumped more than 9% in extended trading after reporting second-quarter revenue that beat analysts' expectations, driven by continued strength in its cloud-computing business. Microsoft had rallied 16% during Thursday's regular session after reporting faster-than-expected Azure cloud growth, reinforcing confidence that AI infrastructure spending remains robust.

Andrew Jackson, head of equity strategy at Ortus Advisors, said Microsoft's stronger-than-expected quarterly results "sparked a huge rebound for risk-on and AI," helping reverse the recent sell-off in technology stocks.

He wrote in a note on Friday that investors were reassured after Azure cloud revenue beat expectations while management kept capital spending "in check," noting that a "'spend at all costs' mentality has been punished by the market."
chineseTitle: 随着 AI 反弹，SK 海力士股价飙升 25%，三星股价飙升超过 20%
chineseSummary: 韩国芯片巨头SK海力士和三星电子周五跟随美国科技股大幅上涨，股价飙升超过20%。
chineseContent:
周五，韩国芯片巨头 SK 海力士和三星电子在首尔股价飙升，追随美国科技股的大幅上涨，此前亚马逊和微软的巨额财报重振了人们对人工智能支出的乐观情绪。

SK 海力士最新股价上涨超过 25%，如果涨幅保持不变，该股有望创下有记录以来的最佳单日表现。三星涨逾20%。 LG Innotek 上涨 11.2%，首尔半导体上涨 7.8%。

日本芯片股也大幅上涨。 Advantest 上涨近 18%，Tokyo Electron 上涨近 9%，Disco 上涨超过 13%，Lasertec 上涨超过 12%，瑞萨电子 (Renesas Electronics) 上涨超过 10%。拥有 Arm 的重要人工智能代理公司软银集团 (SoftBank Group) 股价也上涨超过 9%。

亚洲芯片股的上涨标志着本周惨烈抛售的急剧逆转，因为对人工智能估值过高的担忧以及中国存储芯片制造商竞争加剧的迹象使半导体股票受到重创。

iShares 半导体 ETF (SOXX) 隔夜飙升逾 8%，因这两家美国科技巨头的云计算业绩强于预期，投资者纷纷涌入与人工智能相关的芯片制造商。

受云计算业务持续强劲的推动，亚马逊公布第二季度营收超出分析师预期，其盘后交易价格上涨逾 9%。微软在周四的常规交易中上涨了 16%，此前该公司公布了 Azure 云增长快于预期的消息，增强了人们对人工智能基础设施支出依然强劲的信心。

Ortus Advisors 股票策略主管安德鲁·杰克逊表示，微软强于预期的季度业绩“引发了风险偏好和人工智能的大幅反弹”，帮助扭转了科技股近期的抛售局面。

他在周五的一份报告中写道，Azure 云收入超出预期，同时管理层“控制”资本支出，这让投资者感到放心，并指出“‘不惜一切代价’的心态已受到市场的惩罚”。
